text:
Fixed the `LRUCache.__setitem__` update logic.

Root cause: updating an existing key while the cache was full evicted the oldest entry but appended the updated key again, leaving duplicate queue entries and an inconsistent mapping. Later eviction attempted to remove a key that was already gone.

The cache now removes an existing key from both the mapping and usage queue before re-adding it, while only evicting when inserting a genuinely new key.

final_text:
Fixed the `LRUCache.__setitem__` update logic.

Root cause: updating an existing key while the cache was full evicted the oldest entry but appended the updated key again, leaving duplicate queue entries and an inconsistent mapping. Later eviction attempted to remove a key that was already gone.

The cache now removes an existing key from both the mapping and usage queue before re-adding it, while only evicting when inserting a genuinely new key.
